published.citation: Pinte et al. (2016), Section 3.1: adopted stellar effective temperature, a model input: 4000 K; the source gives no uncertainty, so the range is the value itself, https://doi.org/10.3847/0004-637X/816/1/25

temperature.note: ALMA Partnership et al. (2015), Section 1, describes a heavily obscured star with no directly detected optical photosphere. Its reference sphere uses the 4000 K stellar model of Pinte et al. (2016), rather than treating scattered optical light as a photospheric spectrum., so the color is a Planck spectrum at its published temperature.
